exposure: timing of TAP block (before vs after cesarean section)
Timing of transversus abdominis plane (TAP) block (before vs. after cesarean section)
outcome: Ultrasonographic characteristics of the abdominal wall
finding: The study found that the distance to the transversus abdominis plane (TAP) is deeper after cesarean section compared to before, suggesting that delivery affects sonographic characteristics of the abdominal wall.
mod_finding: The study suggests that obstetricians should be aware of changes in abdominal wall anatomy after delivery when planning a TAP block in the context of cesarean section.
